description:
Story by URI
Fetch one story in full by its `uri` (the `uri` field of any result from `stories_organization_list` or `stories_industry_location_list`, e.g. `https://1145.am/db/14993951/Ai_Cloud-Bytedance_Volcano_Engine`). Returns the detailed story: the same fields as a list result plus archive.org links and `similar_stories`. Activities add `actors` (every organization, person, product or place involved, grouped by role) and `activity_locations`; an IndustrySectorUpdate adds `industry_sector`, `metric`, `locations` and `analyst_organization`. Pass `output=simple` for just the list-result fields. Returns 404 if no story has that uri. Payment: send an API key, or pay $0.02 per call in USDC on Base via x402 (charged only when the call returns results; first 50 calls per wallet free from 30 November to 7 December 2026, though the wallet must hold at least $0.02 in USDC). Terms: https://syracuse.1145.am/terms

output.description: Output format. Defaults to "full". Use "simple" for the list-result fields only.

uri.description: The story's `uri`, as returned in stories results.

name: stories_retrieve
